objective: Translate the Kolob/Sirius/central-anchor theory into an evidence-first audit using the same reproducible claim-boundary style used for PHAT-MICRO-0003.
claim_boundary: This project can test textual/astronomical correspondences and physical feasibility. It cannot prove theology, divine ontology, or baptismal truth claims from telescope data.

text_claims.claim: Kolob is described as one of the great celestial bodies nearest to the throne/governing center.
text_claims.source: Book of Abraham 3, official LDS scripture text

text_claims.claim: One Kolob day/revolution is described as one thousand Earth years.
text_claims.source: Book of Abraham 3:4, official LDS scripture text

text_claims.claim: The text arranges bodies by relative greatness, reckoning, time, and governing order.
text_claims.source: Book of Abraham 3:3-9, official LDS scripture text

physics_hypotheses.name: Textual or ritual cosmology
physics_hypotheses.description: The passage is a theological/cosmological ordering system, not a map to a physical object.
physics_hypotheses.expected_observables: No unique astronomical coordinate, no required mass, no falsifiable telescope target.

physics_hypotheses.name: Keplerian time ladder
physics_hypotheses.description: The one-thousand-year value is an orbital/revolution period, not relativistic time dilation.
physics_hypotheses.expected_observables: A 1000-year orbital period maps to a calculable semi-major axis around a chosen central mass.

physics_hypotheses.name: General-relativity time dilation
physics_hypotheses.description: The one-day-to-one-thousand-years ratio is literal gravitational time dilation near a compact object.
physics_hypotheses.expected_observables: A stationary clock must sit extremely close to an event horizon; stable matter/orbits become the main failure test.

physics_hypotheses.name: Galactic-center analog
physics_hypotheses.description: Kolob is being mapped onto Sagittarius A* or a central-mass anchor of the Milky Way.
physics_hypotheses.expected_observables: Known S-star orbits, infrared/X-ray/radio flares, and EHT constraints should match or reject specific claims.

physics_hypotheses.name: Sirius/Dogon cross-cultural anchor
physics_hypotheses.description: Sirius traditions preserve independent knowledge of a hidden dense companion or central anchor.
physics_hypotheses.expected_observables: Claims must survive historical source audit, contamination checks, and modern Sirius system astrometry.

physics_hypotheses.name: Hidden compact object / PBH search
physics_hypotheses.description: The useful scientific residue is a search for compact dark objects via microlensing/astrometry, independent of theological proof.
physics_hypotheses.expected_observables: Microlensing events, stellar acceleration residuals, Gaia astrometric anomalies, X-ray/radio non-detections.
